description: Studiemateriaal per subject: lesson material from the study planner (by date), year attachments by folder (file links), external links, and methods/publisher links (book fund). Without arguments: the subjects that have material, plus personal learning products when the school allows it. vak = name, abbreviation or uuid; all=true fetches every subject. Every item lists bijlagen (fileUrl, readable with download_attachment) and externeMaterialen; empty means the teacher attached nothing (lesmateriaal=true is only a flag, there is no separate material call).

leerlingId.description: Numeric leerling id. Required when more than one child is linked.
